_about: Test cases for the Nothing protocol. crc_check is the published check value of CRC-16/MODBUS, which Nothing X's Utils.obtainCrc16 computes. frames were built by hand with an independent implementation (Python, outside the repo) from the layout in docs/nothing/PROTOCOL.md section 2; they are not captures. payloads were read from real devices by nada (github.com/chukfinley/nada, MIT, a CMF Buds 2 Plus, B184) and nadamas (github.com/ezvk/nadamas, MIT, an Ear (3a), B190, and a CMF Buds Pro 2, B187), as their notes give them; nothing that names or addresses a device is kept.

frames.what: read the noise report's three groups (C01E 03), fsn 3
Ultra Bass on at level 4 (F051 01 04), fsn 9, the write nada tried on a B184
read the battery on an Ear (1), which takes no CRC

replies.what: a noise report from the earbuds (401E) with a CRC

b184_noise_transparency.source: nada, CMF Buds 2 Plus: after setting transparency

b184_noise_high.source: nada, CMF Buds 2 Plus: after setting ANC high

b190_model.source: nadamas, Ear (3a): the device model read

b187_model.source: nadamas, CMF Buds Pro 2: the device model read
